title: 白墨选择
intent: 两条 TIFF 路线都需明确选择0/1/2像素分支及理由。
brief: Stage 7 生成与审核 active substep "白墨选择". Title "选择白墨类型". Three radio cards with NONE SELECTED: "精细图案 · 内缩 0 px" / "普通图案 · 内缩 1 px" / "大块实底 · 内缩 2 px". Small suitable fox preview; explanation "根据完整图案选择，系统不会自动判断。"; text area label "选择理由" empty placeholder "说明本次选择的依据". Disabled primary "确认白墨选择" until both selection and reason exist. Collapsed technical disclosure "生产通道说明" with visible small note "源 PSD/PDF 的专色不会直接沿用。". No "use existing white ink" option.
